risk_note: RV2 by path (orders). Puts Jingdong on the schedule per D10-543 and 02 §7.1: syncWindowCapMs is 60 minutes (CAP-JD-07), so jd joins the increment schedule and manual sync and jd.csv loads at worker start. orderSyncPorts now injects rescanConfig, which arms the rescan timers: jd on and pdd off by the existing defaults (FU-PDD-RESCAN-QUOTA), no platform name in app.module. The config port takes no App, so it reads the fixed app couli, following RETENTION_APP_ID; building it reads nothing, every get reads again, and a failed read propagates so the rescan skips that round. The jd endpoint stays demo and queryableAccount is null without live credentials, so no window goes out and no external call is made. Taobao stays unscheduled.
